query: When should I submit my top-up application if I want to be eligible for tax relief in the next assessment year?
reference_answer: Your online top-up application and payment will need to reach us by 31 December of the year.It is important to note that the tax relief is granted based on the calendar year in which the top-up is made, regardless of the actual date of submission.We would also encourage you to top up earlier in the year. Find outwhy you should top up as early as possible.
answer: You should submit your top-up application before the start of the tax year to be eligible for tax relief in the next assessment year. [Document 1]
